title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
content: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
content: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
content: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
content: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
content: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
content: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
content: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.

title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
content: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
content: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Trezor Says Customer Data Was Exposed Again
content: A second Trezor shipping partner was breached in three months, exposing buyers' addresses and order details.

title: Bitcoin's $2 Billion Liquidation Weekend Leaves Traders Watching $60,000
content: Bitcoin fell near $62,100 as forced liquidations swept crypto markets. ETF withdrawals and a crowded options trade offer a closer look at the damage left behind.

title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
content: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”

title: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
content: The firm’s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a “waterfall” drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.

title: Clarity Act Defeat ‘Failure of American Leadership’: Trump’s Former Crypto Chief
content: Former White House crypto chief Patrick Witt said the Clarity Act "lost against the clock," and regulators will now set the rules.

title: Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5%
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5% Bitcoin price held near $65,000 on Monday afternoon, shrugging off a 2.5% Nasdaq slide as Nvidia's board ruled out bringing back Jensen Huang and the dollar hit a 19-month high. This post Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday
content: Bitcoin Magazine Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday The Senate Agriculture Committee will hear Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland on Tuesday, President Trump's bipartisan picks to join CFTC Chairman Michael Selig, currently the agency's only sitting commissioner. This post Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin AnchorWatch CEO Rob Hamilton is bullish on Bitcoin in the long run, even as he watches liquidity get pulled toward the Anthropic IPO and the AI trade, which he compares to a black hole. This post Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

title: $36B Wealth Firm Strategist: Bitcoin’s Supercycle Is “Still Intact”
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine $36B Wealth Firm Strategist: Bitcoin’s Supercycle Is “Still Intact” James Thorne, Chief Market Strategist at Wellington-Altus, tells BMTV that Bitcoin's super cycle is still intact after the drop from about 83,000 in mid-October to around 64,000.
